subject.title: Feishu plugin WebSocket doesn't receive im.message.receive_v1 events

question: Should a Feishu owner run live WebSocket diagnostics before ClawSweeper queues a code fix for this issue?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the intended SDK wiring but cannot prove why one live event type is missing while lifecycle events arrive; choosing a fix without Feishu credentials risks changing the wrong layer.

options.title: Run live Feishu diagnostics first
options.body: Capture redacted Feishu SDK and gateway logs that show whether `im.message.receive_v1` reaches the SDK, dispatcher, parser, and router before selecting a code fix.

options.title: Attach to an existing Feishu inbound issue
options.body: Only treat this as covered by an existing issue or PR if live logs show the same partial-runtime, proxy, or status/liveness root cause.

options.title: Defer as unsupported proof gap
options.body: Keep the issue open without a repair lane until a maintainer or reporter can provide live evidence from a configured Feishu tenant.

recommendation.title: Run live Feishu diagnostics first
recommendation.body: Capture redacted Feishu SDK and gateway logs that show whether `im.message.receive_v1` reaches the SDK, dispatcher, parser, and router before selecting a code fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata identifies this handle as the Feishu/Lark plugin community-maintenance contact, and the missing proof requires Feishu-specific live channel expertise.
